trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was unhealthy across all regions on v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate, following the latest deploy. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions** — the first attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east; a retry completed us-west and eu-west. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery** — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) confirmed on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the final healthy state. On-call has been paged.
